svg.title: Logo clear space and minimum size
svg.desc: The CORE UBB lockup surrounded by clear space equal to half its height on every side, with the site tag cap height marked as the element that sets the minimum reproduction size.
svg.text: one avocado of space on every side — which is half the lockup height
≈ 44 mm wide — below this “UBB CLUJ” fills in
only where CORE is already named
The smallest element sets the floor: the site tag’s cap height is 12.7% of the lockup height,
so a 12 mm lockup puts that cap at 1.5 mm — the point where small caps stop surviving ink spread.
